sin.name: listener-hears-every-model
sin.description: A commit listener hears every model change.
sin.rule: Declare the specific row or domain event the listener needs. Temporary named exceptions: dock_item_leave_listener and skill_event_listener await task 6607; reply_link_listener and worker_test_listener await task 6608. Sequence end and row trigger listeners cover row types declared by installed sequence steps and triggers, so their model set is open.
